recommendation: Keep the published source fix. No additional core FHIR action is needed for FHIR-38050 unless BRR later approves different wording for these classifier definitions or reopens the external binding question in a separate applicable issue.
issue_request: FHIR-38050 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested an updated ResearchStudy.classifier definition: remove blinding/randomization examples, add FDA regulated device, FDA regulated drug, MPG Paragraph 23b, and IRB-exempt examples, and replace the ResearchStudy Classifiers CodeSystem values with those four classifier concepts.
initial_application: Commit 866b02bd46 partially applied J# 38050 by changing ResearchStudy.classifier and replacing classifier values; commit fea29a0b59 completed definitions for the four codes. Current source preserves the requested classifier examples and four classifier concepts, but the IRB-exempt definition retained the misspelling 'excempt'.
additional_context: ResearchStudy is active in source/fhir.ini, so the edited ResearchStudy terminology source is in current build scope. Later FHIR-39003 work and the February 2023 committers Zulip thread reorganized the same terminology area by splitting unrelated external classifier/status/study-design content out of the CodeSystem, explaining why the current CodeSystem now contains only the four FHIR-38050 concepts. FHIR-55604 later resolved no-change for replacing ResearchStudy.classifier's binding with an EBM IG value set, so no binding change is appropriate here.
reconciliation: Changed source/researchstudy/codesystem-research-study-classifiers.xml so the IRB-exempt definition reads 'exempt from oversight' rather than 'excempt from oversight'. No other source changes were made because the main classifier definition and code replacement requested by FHIR-38050 are already present.
source_changes: source/researchstudy/codesystem-research-study-classifiers.xml: corrected the IRB-exempt concept definition spelling from 'excempt' to 'exempt'.
